So this is an article from a conspiracy site that claims documents have been obtained showing some massive cover up about vaccines. Not one link in that article is from a credible source. The links all come from these notoriously inaccurate and unreliable sources (among others):

-naturalnews.com

-mercola.com

-foodfreedom

The document in question is linked at the bottom of the article. It's by one single individual, rather than a committee of individuals from different medical specialties, so right there the credibility is shot. A few of her papers continue to claim that vaccines cause autism.

I'm not surprised that the conspiracy theorists buy into this kind of crap. They continually post links from naturalnew, mercola.com and claim that medicine and the always elusive "big pharam" is not telling us the truth.
